governance_bootstrap.summary: Read Must/Never, approval semantics, red-team-CEO-triggered-only basic rule, completion-evidence requirement before code push.
Read git/deploy invariants (SoT=origin/main, SSH-only remote, no force-push) and gate invariants before pushing scripts/ changes.

verification.name: harness-smartfarm-hub systemd service running on real Raspberry Pi
verification.result: active (running), enabled for boot; confirmed after deploying hub.py fix and starting the unit.

verification.name: hub.py Python 3.9 PEP-604 crash fix verified on real device runtime
verification.command: ssh pi@192.168.0.23 timeout smoke test of hub.py after adding `from __future__ import annotations`
verification.result: hub.py previously crashed on every real run (Python 3.9.2 rejects `X | None` syntax); after the fix it started cleanly and stayed up under systemd with no exception.

verification.name: real zone2 sensor readings logged into live smartfarm.db
verification.command: scp pi@192.168.0.23:/home/pi/harness-smartfarm-pi-hub/smartfarm.db . ; python3 -c "import sqlite3; ..." to inspect rows
verification.result: 32 real soil_pct rows logged over the last hour from the physical ESP8266 node, not synthetic data.

verification.name: openclaw_smartfarm_research_bridge.py alerts command against live Pi snapshot
verification.result: correctly reported no_data_ever for zone1 (ESP32 not deployed) and zone2 temp_c/humidity_pct (DHT22 not yet reporting), plus real sensor_stuck + pump_short_cycling alerts for zone2 soil_pct.

verification.name: openclaw_smartfarm_research_bridge.py report + threshold-propose against live Pi snapshot
verification.result: report matched live db aggregates (count/min/max/avg); threshold-propose correctly refused a numeric suggestion (kind=investigate_before_adjusting) because the soil sensor looked stuck, instead of tuning against a broken signal.

verification.name: threshold propose->decide->apply approval gate, real file writes
verification.command: propose -> threshold-decide rejected/approved -> threshold-apply, run as separate CLI processes against a real sqlite db and config.yaml copy
verification.result: apply before any decision -> PermissionError; apply after rejection -> PermissionError; apply after approval -> succeeded and patched only the targeted zone/keys while preserving all other lines/Korean comments verbatim.
